# Super Agent Skill MCP — LLM Discovery Index

## What this project is
`super-agent-skill` is a free, open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that equips AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, OpenAI Codex) with 64 production-grade tools spanning 29 specialized modules.

## Who it is for
- **Startup founders** building fast at **$0/month infrastructure cost** with curated free developer tiers, free APIs, auth, legal terms, SaaS pricing, and marketing copy on autopilot.
- **Full-stack developers** who want design system blueprints, Docker setups, security audits, and CI/CD workflows in seconds.
- **AI engineers** building RAG pipelines, local LLM apps, multi-agent orchestration, and vector DB systems.

## How to install
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "super-agent-skill": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "github:Akash1070/Super-Agent-Skill"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Core Capabilities
- $0/Month Founder Infrastructure Blueprint (Vercel, Neon DB, Upstash Redis, Groq LLM, Resend Email, Cloudflare R2, PostHog)
- 100% Free Public APIs Directory (scouted from `free-for-dev` 87k★ and `public-apis` 300k★)
- Gold-Level 4-Tier Persistent Memory Learning (preferences, mistake autopsies, scouted intelligence, community wisdom)
- Federated Community Memory Sync — 100+ developers share anonymized best practices automatically
- 24-Hour Autonomous GitHub Scout Cron — agent knowledge stays fresh forever
- SEO + AEO + GEO Discovery Engine — generates llms.txt, JSON-LD, and Perplexity/SearchGPT citation blocks
- Alex Hormozi $100M Offer Marketing Copy & Ad Blueprint Generator
- RAG & Vector DB Architecture (ChromaDB, Qdrant, Pinecone + LangChain/LangGraph)
- OWASP Security Auditor + Hardening Code Generator
- Multi-Stage Docker + Nginx Reverse Proxy + Deployment Checklist
- Fintech & Quantitative Trading Loop Blueprints
- Multimodal AI (Whisper, Vision LLMs, Synthetic Data)
